label: PORTFOLIO PROJECT · v2.10.0
app_name: Life in the UK Test Practice
tagline: Pass the citizenship test — in English and Cantonese.
problem: Hong Kong BN(O) migrants must pass an English-only test on 24 random questions; existing apps ignore Cantonese speakers.
solution: An offline PWA with 480 questions, full Cantonese translation, a real exam simulator and a personal study plan.

features.title: Random exam
features.desc: 24 of 480 questions, max one per study fact.

features.title: Cantonese mode
features.desc: Every question, option and note in colloquial HK Cantonese.

features.title: Study plan
features.desc: Phased daily tasks from exam date, time budget and rest days.

features.title: Similar questions
features.desc: Links each question to its study fact and sibling questions.
